changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction. Layouts and live previews may contain errors; visual acceptance in the Gameface client is pending.

Keep shared vehicle-marker reference actions inside the property column. Edit referenced model properties without replacing the reference, allow input fields to shrink, and resolve colour macros before assigning swatch CSS.

Use exactly two fictional carousel examples, T32 and Object 140, instead of account inventory/dossier snapshots. Calculate sample statistic colours through the live carousel colour API and the palette selected in the settings draft.

Align carousel preview base text colour/font size, independent icon size, field alignment, macro background colours and shadow options with the live card renderer. Anchor the native vehicle name to the right; remaining native-layout differences still need in-game validation.

Target WoT 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Include regression coverage for shared-model edits, fictional sample isolation and carousel field rendering. Existing 0.1.3 settings are retained; the published stable release is unchanged.
